== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow was baptised on 8 June 1800 at Kirknewton and East Calder according to the held FamilySearch abstract. His exact birth date is not established by that citation; he was born by the baptism day.<ref>[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-TVX FamilySearch, Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950], Thomas Glasgow, christening 8 June 1800, Kirknewton and East Calder, father Thomas Glasgow and mother Margaret Chapman; previously held citation, original register uninspected.</ref> The selected father [[Glasgow-1620|Thomas Glasgow]] remains assessed at 98%; the [[Chapman-28491|Margaret Chapman]] maternal identity is not newly graded.

== Research Notes ==
=== Birth bound and repeated-name identity ===
The held FamilySearch citation labels 8 June 1800 as christening, not an explicit birthday. Replace the inherited exact birth with the inclusive upper bound by 8 June 1800, encoded as before 9 June. This includes a possible same-day birth; 9 June is an exclusive boundary, not a claimed birthday. The 1796 Thomas to the same named parental couple remains a possible identity: two baptism entries alone do not establish brothers or an early death. Retain parent assessments, the older birth claim and both source events; no merge or new person. Original register uninspected.

The OPR derivative SCOT/OPR/BAP/4478159 supplies birth 3 July 1796, Thos Glasgow and Margt Chapman at Clifton; its baptism field is blank. The older FamilySearch abstract labels 17 July 1796 as christening. These fields must retain their separate event roles.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4478159 Findmypast derivative SCOT/OPR/BAP/4478159], OPR 690/3 item 2 page 44; inspected 30 October 2026, original uninspected.</ref>


=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1620]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Thomas-1620’s held FamilySearch citation explicitly indexes Thomas as father of Thomas, christened8 June 1800 at Kirknewton/East Calder. This is the recorded 8 June 1800 baptism. A separate family abstract gives a Thomas baptism on 17 July 1796, while the inspected OPR derivative explicitly labels 3 July 1796 as birth. Those are distinct documented events, but do not alone prove two people or the early death of the first child. An earlier birth or repeated baptism is not concretely excluded, so identification with the 1796 child remains a qualified possibility.

Whole selected father-profile proposition; maternity and upstream ancestry assessed separately.
